_doc: Constructor mark provenance (2026 field). A mark renders publicly ONLY when approved_public is true. Commons "Public domain" on a logo is a copyright determination (simple text/geometry); it is not a trademark licence. Every team mark is a registered trademark of its owner and PropBetEdge holds no permission, so all are HELD and PBEcast renders the PropBetEdge team wordmark badge (team code + team colour) instead. Owner can approve a specific mark by flipping approved_public with a recorded decision.
